name: io.github.agent402-dev/bond-seller-mcp
description: Sell jobs backed by Agent402 Bond deals on Solana (USDC or PREQ) from your own seller wallet.

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELLER_KEYPAIR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the seller wallet key file (Solana CLI JSON). Required.

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELLER_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Solana mainnet RPC URL. Required.

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_ASSET
environmentVariables.description: Deal asset: USDC (default) or PREQ (Token-2022)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_PRICE
environmentVariables.description: Price per job in the deal asset (decimal). Required.

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_BOND
environmentVariables.description: Seller bond per job in the deal asset (at most 20% of the price). Required.

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_DEPOSIT
environmentVariables.description: Buyer deposit in the deal asset (default 0)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_DELIVER_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds you promise to deliver in (default 3600)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_LATE_WINDOW_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Late window in seconds, 0 to 7 days (default 0)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_PAY_WINDOW_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Buyer pay window in seconds, 1 to 30 days (default 86400)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_PROTOCOL
environmentVariables.description: 2 = sell over Agent402 Bond v2 (Job Protocol v2); 1 = Bond v1 (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_GRACE_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: v2: time after the delivery deadline during which you may still mark (1 hour to 1 day, default 86400)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_REVIEW_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: v2: time the buyer has to accept after your mark (1 hour to 7 days, default 86400)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_DESCRIPTION
environmentVariables.description: Plain text shown in the quote (at most 500 characters)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_BUYERS
environmentVariables.description: Only these buyer addresses, comma-separated (default anyone)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_MAX_PENDING
environmentVariables.description: Deals in progress at once (default 3)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_MAX_PER_BUYER
environmentVariables.description: Deals in progress per buyer (default 1)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_MAX_UNCONFIRMED_PER_BUYER
environmentVariables.description: Refuse buyers with this many unconfirmed deliveries (default 2)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Serve the Bond Job Protocol over HTTP on this port (default off)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_HOST
environmentVariables.description: HTTP listen address (default 127.0.0.1)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
environmentVariables.description: Origin buyers use, when behind a proxy or tunnel

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELLER_STORE
environmentVariables.description: Job store file (default ~/.agent402/seller-jobs.json)

environmentVariables.name: BOND_SELL_INTERVAL_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Background loop interval in seconds (default 60, at least 30)
